format: JavaScript (probably JSX syntax for Lightning JS)
description: This file defines a reusable UI component named 'ProductCard' for a Lightning JS application, used to display product details and allow quantity adjustment and adding products to a cart.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A Lightning component that displays product information, including image, description, and controls for quantity adjustment and adding to cart.

methods.name: $increment
methods.description: Increases the quantity (qty) up to the maximum stock or 99.

methods.name: $decrement
methods.description: Decreases the quantity (qty) down to a minimum of 1.

methods.name: $addToCart
methods.description: Adds the current product and selected quantity to the shopping cart and provides visual feedback by changing the alpha value temporarily.
